name: West Bengal
description: Discover the breathtaking seasonal beauty, rich cultural heritage, and legendary gastronomy of West Bengal.

cuisine.name: Kolkata Mutton Biryani
cuisine.desc: Fragrant saffron rice served with tender meat, soft boiled egg & spiced potato.

cuisine.name: Nolen Gurer Sandesh
cuisine.desc: Delicate cottage cheese sweet made with fresh date palm jaggery available only in winter.

cuisine.name: Kosha Mangsho with Luchi
cuisine.desc: Rich slow-cooked dark mutton curry served with puffed fried bread.

festivals.name: West Bengal Festival
festivals.desc: A vibrant regional celebration of culture and heritage.
